management_notes: Listed on the CSE March 31, 2026 as a spin-out from American Pacific Mining Corp, which retained approximately 10%. American Pacific's management has credible Nevada exploration experience. ICG itself has no operating history as an independent company and has not yet executed a modern drill program. The inherited dataset and the Tuscarora District acquisition from AP Mining are assets, but the management team has yet to prove it can convert historical data into a drillable resource.
geology_notes: Tuscarora District, northeastern Nevada: 10,000 contiguous acres at the intersection of the Independence and Carlin Trends — two of Nevada's premier gold and silver addresses. Historical dataset is substantial: 5,000 samples, 25,000m of historical drilling, and 130 km of geophysical surveys by previous operators. Targeting two known mineralized zones (South Navajo and Modoc) as well as undrilled blue-sky targets (East Pediment, Grand Prize, King's Vein). The epithermal silver-gold setting is geologically credible, but all data is historical and has not been validated by modern systematic drilling.
capital_notes: Raised aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $4.5M in subscription receipt and unit offerings prior to listing. American Pacific Mining retains approximately 10% with associated overhang. A 3,000-6,000m RC drill program against a ~$4.5M treasury leaves minimal margin for error or market weakness. A follow-on financing round before year-end 2026 is highly probable. No extracted cap-table data available in the filings cache for this ticker.
catalyst_notes: Phase 1 RC drill program of 3,000-6,000m is scheduled to commence June 2026 — approximately one month from the date of this report. Assay results are expected in August 2026. This is the single defining binary catalyst for the company. A positive result at South Navajo or one of the undrilled targets could drive substantial re-rating; a negative result leaves a company with a depleted treasury and no clear path to additional drilling.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists. P/NAV is not calculable at this stage. Nevada is a favorable jurisdiction for M&A given permitting certainty and established infrastructure, and Carlin/Independence Trend addresses do attract acquirer attention. However, with no modern drilling results and a pre-resource status, no acquirer will bid until at minimum a maiden resource is defined. Comparable pre-resource Nevada transactions suggest significant upside if the Tuscarora system is confirmed — but that outcome is entirely speculative ahead of the June 2026 program.
analyst_summary: ICG Silver & Gold is a newly minted CSE explorer with a genuinely interesting address — the Tuscarora District sits at the intersection of Nevada's Carlin and Independence Trends with a large inherited historical dataset. The June 2026 Phase 1 drill program is the defining catalyst, with results expected August 2026. However, the company only listed March 31, 2026, carries just ~$4.5M in the treasury, and is entirely pre-drill. Third-party analysis has flagged some concern about the robustness of the inherited historical numbers. The near-term drill catalyst and Nevada address justify a WATCH, but the binary risk ahead of August results and the thin treasury cap confidence at low. No extracted cap-table or resource data was available in the filings cache for this ticker.
